goal.original: Find out why SeedVR2 still looks bad, then get SeedVR2 + PiD research-complete and workflow-ready WITHOUT implementing anything in the app - Fabio's call: this is a 1.5 job, 1.4 ships first.
goal.summary: SeedVR2's quality failure was root-caused to three widget-level defects and Fabio confirmed the fix on his bench. Both cards are research-complete and deliberately unimplemented. What remains is the image path test, the repo-side runtime workflows, and one --lowvram measurement.

completed: REFUTED the incoming hypothesis: the image path is not the suspect. Frame 1 of the bad video run measured 15x the laplacian energy of lanczos, so SeedVR2 was never a no-op and the single-frame control test was unnecessary.
Defect 1 - temporal_overlap 8 clamps to chunk_latent-1, forcing step=1, so every interior latent is the running mean of ~3 independent one-step restorations. Ghosts moving subjects. Ship 2.
Defect 2 - chunking_mode auto allowed chunk_latent=3 where 15 runs and 21 OOMs. Bigger chunks are also faster (268s vs 409s). Ship manual.
Defect 3 - color_correction_method none leaves smooth luma drift, NOT tile seams (seam-gradient test on the VAE tile grid returned 1.02). lab cuts worst-case drift 36 -> 19. Ship lab.
Fabio picked fpc=57 from the review clips and CONFIRMED the fixed video workflow works on his bench.

key_decisions: 1.5, NOT 1.4 (Fabio, 2026-08-10). SeedVR2 integration and the PiD plugin move are explicitly deferred; 1.4 ships first. Research and workflows land now, app wiring does not.
frames_per_chunk = 57 at 1.5x on a 16GB card - Fabio's call from the clips. The laplacian metric preferred 33 and was WRONG; it counts grain as detail. Rank with eyes, diagnose with the metric.

Keep the CORE SeedVR2 nodes. comfyorg/comfyui_seedvr2 is a zero-star stale fork of numz's pre-core pack and comfyorg is not Comfy-Org; adopting it would cost int8_convrot (30-series users), add a node_lock entry, and put a 16GB self-downloader outside the dependency manager.

MPI-507's Flow blocker needs NO new mechanism. FlowDef.requiredDeps already takes dep ids (MPI-304; head-swap ships it) and dep status is stat-based via the id-agnostic /comfy/models/check, so installing a plugin unlocks the flow. flowSdxl4k drops nvidia-pid from requiredModels for pid-sdxl, vae-sdxl, pid-gemma, comfyui-kjnodes - strictly smaller than the ModelDef's four-architecture union.
constraints: ASK FABIO BEFORE ANY GENERATION. Another agent is using the GPU as of 2026-08-10.
DO NOT IMPLEMENT IN THE APP. No js/, no routes/. Workflows in comfy_workflows/ are fine; wiring them is 1.5.

The chunk ceiling (15 latents OK, 21 OOM) was measured under NORMAL_VRAM on the :8188 bench. The app launches --lowvram on every NVIDIA GPU (routes/comfy.js:432), which changes both what get_free_memory() reads and peak allocation. Defects 1 and 3 are pure arithmetic / post-process and carry NO such caveat; only the frames_per_chunk NUMBER is bench-only.
fpc=57 is calibrated for 1.5x. At 2x the per-frame cost is ~1.8x higher and it will OOM - use ~29. Input_Low_VRAM must stay true; false bypasses the chunker and a single 21-latent chunk OOMs.

SHARED TREE, and it is busy. Peer sessions committed during this one (660e297b) and own MPI-504, docs/, js/data/modelConstants/modelDeps.js, tests/, plus 10 pending_file_states. Commit by explicit pathspec only, never git add -A.

The 9 modified comfy_workflows/*.json in git status are a core.autocrlf=true artifact, NOT edits - verified byte-identical to HEAD, git diff --numstat empty. Do not try to 'fix' them; unpicking it needs a banned git command.
NEVER delete the pid-* / vae-* / pid-gemma dep entries - the orphan sweep reads DEPS and a deletion strands those weights on existing users' disks forever.
Convert workflows against the ENGINE on :48188, not the :8188 bench - the bench runs ahead and has silently shifted a widget before.
MpiLoadVideo has no trim, so the official template's trim -> segment -> merge advice and a single-chunk control run are both unavailable.
